$comment: Per-variant visual specs for published Pushpin components — fill, stroke, radius, size, padding and the first text descendant, as they render in the kit. A bound variable is recorded as [collection, name, literal]: the collection and name verbatim from Figma, and the value that renders beside them. Several bindings have no --pp-* counterpart and inventing one is the defect this capture exists to remove, so resolution happens in scripts/lib/specs.mjs against tokens.figma.json. Generated — see scripts/build-specs.mjs, and scripts/extract.md § Component visual specs for the read.
